user_questions: What is the Smile Discovery Consultation?
What happens in the first consultation?
intents.voice_response: Think of meeting an architect for the first time — before any plans are drawn, they want to understand your vision. The USD Smile Discovery Consultation works the same way. Your Authorized Smile Designer listens to your concerns, understands your goals, and evaluates your smile before anything is planned.
intents.follow_up: Would you like to know what happens right after that, in the Smile Vision Analysis?
